items.title: A flat finite type algebra over a Noetherian ring with geometrically integral fibres is projective as a module
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a flat finite type algebra S over a Noetherian ring R whose fibre rings are geometrically integral is projective as an R-module (statement lines 2178-2190, tag 05FS). The proof is a genuine contradiction argument: a maximal ideal over which projectivity fails is shown to be radical by lifting projectivity along a nilpotent ideal, generic flatness then provides a faithfully flat presentation of R by a localisation and an adic completion, and projectivity of the completed base change is checked through the criterion for flat pure modules using that the fibre associated primes are unique and that the chosen element lies in the Jacobson radical of a complete ring. The reduction to the complete case is the substance, so the claim is H2.
